description: Runs ASR models exported to ONNX through the onnx-asr library, without a PyTorch dependency. This fighter runs the CTC-head Parakeet 1.1B model for English, distinct from the TDT-head Parakeet variants already in the registry.
notes: Model from the OpenVoiceOS 'stt-asr-onnx' HuggingFace collection.
